measure_canonical_demon.method: New canonical_api_small workload, no pre-M3f5 API baseline. Three separate release processes. 100 parses/constructors/typed batches timed separately; 100 direct canonical ATK2 entries each in a fresh same-input setup, target/roster installation outside timers; 1000 complete binding/definition queries; 100 existing script updates each preceded by a canonical identity query, including snapshots. Native wait4 peak RSS covers process/allocator overhead. Not directly comparable with old workloads that omit these queries, no isolated CPU/frequency control, no performance threshold.

measure_context_ownership.method: New separate microbenchmark, not a historical before baseline. Three release processes per path. 100000 raw permissive target lookups versus scoped generation/definition/role-aware observations (additional validation differs);100 replacements;100 mark/step-snapshot/spawn/stale-check cycles. Setup/token admission excluded. Same inputs, mutation sequence and final digest. Native wait4 RSS; no CPU/frequency isolation or allocation instrumentation. Do not interpret raw lookup latency as equivalent validation or compare this workload with whole-simulation benchmarks.

measure_demon_expanded_map.method: Three separate Linux release processes per source-backed input/profile; 100 parses and full constructors timed separately (ownership passed, no parsing/clone in prepare timer); 100 THING batches timed after construction for typed profiles only; 1000 immutable collision and sight queries; 100 direct Chase calls each on fresh same-input targets for typed profiles only; 100 script updates including external scripted damage and Snapshot construction, then 100 complete canonical encodings. Native wait4 RSS includes benchmark/Rust allocator/event overhead, not Python launch pages. Profile17 prepared metrics unavailable (null); profile19 has no typed batch/Chase (zero timer is not claimed execution). Only small_control17/20 are like-for-like gameplay inputs; other sizes/profiles are different workloads. No performance threshold or universal regression claim

measure_game_instance.method: New workload, not a historical before baseline. Three separate release processes per path. Setup/admission excluded. Both time 100000 validated imports and 100000 checked exports (including returned Arc drop); then 100 same-input snapshot-inclusive updates with target observations. Scoped path retains one already scoped actor; qualified path explicitly reimports the same reference on every update. Different boundary validation work is intentional; ordinary tic logic never automatically imports references. Native wait4 peak RSS, no allocation counter or CPU/frequency isolation. Preserve all samples/outliers.

measure_original_registry.method: Three separate release processes each. New original-ID workloads; no before baseline and diagnostic volume differs from legacy. 100 parses/constructors/batches/direct entries timed separately; setup excluded from direct-entry timers. 100000 immutable direct lookups and identity queries. 100 existing script updates include snapshots; 100 bounded encodes/decodes separately. Native wait4 RSS includes process/allocator/events. No isolated CPU/frequency control or threshold; preserve every sample/outlier.

stepping.method: Three separate release processes per workload/mode. Setup excluded; update timers include identical scripted inputs and destruction of returned snapshots. Capture uses frozen state after100 advances; encode uses a prebuilt snapshot. These frozen components are not additive to evolving update medians. Allocation samples are separate instrumented processes, NOT timing/RSS samples. Linux/glibc interposition counts successful malloc/calloc/aligned requests, realloc requests, cumulative requested bytes and explicit nonnull frees in the marked workload thread; allocator internals/direct mappings/other threads/peak-live-heap/leaks are not measured. Native wait4 RSS includes setup, allocator, events and final verification capture/encoding outside timer. Private component samples include test-harness RSS, are100 calls on frozen initial state and are separate from evolving update work. Staging bytes include vacant logical slots; spatial allocation reserves max_slots while copying only current links. No CPU/frequency/host isolation, timing thresholds or universal performance claim.
